display.purpose: Hero headlines and major architectural section titles.

headline.purpose: Bento cell headers and feature section headings.

shadows.name: modal-overlay
shadows.purpose: Depth elevation reserved exclusively for floating dialogs and audit modals.

motion.name: ease-architectural
motion.purpose: Decisive, damped mechanical easing for tab switches and micro-transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-emphasis action trigger with sharp 4px corners and inverted monochrome contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #EDEDED; color: #0D0D0E; font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #EDEDED; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FFFFFF; opacity: 0.95; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline secondary action button for mode toggles and low-emphasis actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #A0A0A5; font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #EDEDED; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Telemetry Chip
components.description: Tabular mono metric pill with 1px border and zero neon tint.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #D0D0D5; font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Architectural Card
components.description: Grounded container panel with 1px hairline border and subtle hover border brightening.
components.html:
NVIDIA Deep Learning Fellowship
$25,000 • 94% Match
components.css: .ds-card { background: #131315; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); border-radius: 4px; padding: 20px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Host Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #EDEDED; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-metric { font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #82828B; }

components.name: Data Field Input
components.description: Architectural mono/sans field with 4px corners and elevated background.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Intended Major / Discipline" value="Computer Engineering" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1A1A1D; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); color: #EDEDED; font-family: 'Host Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; outline: none; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); outline: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: ScholarGrid is built as a high-density, mathematical command ledger for ambitious students navigating complex scholarship opportunities. Rejecting the rounded, pastel, gamified aesthetics typical of consumer EdTech, ScholarGrid approaches scholarship hunting as an auditable allocation problem. The visual language evokes precision laboratory instrumentation, architectural blueprints, and high-frequency financial workstations.
keyCharacteristics: Strict Monochrome Discipline: High-contrast neutral spectrum (deep obsidian #0D0D0E and engineered paper #F8FAFC); zero neon, zero synthetic glow.

Micro-Metric Typographic Hierarchy: Host Grotesk for architectural titles and proportional prose, Azeret Mono with tabular numerals for all telemetry, and Instrument Serif italic for humanizing donor intentions.
Razor Corner Radii: Uniform 4px boundaries on all cards, inputs, and interactive surfaces.
Cartesian Grid Structure: 32px hairline background coordinate grid creating spatial grounding across viewport widths.

rules.name: The Zero-Neon Rule
rules.body: No saturated cyan, purple, or green accents. Statuses are communicated via typographic weight, structural icons, and mono labels, never colored pills or glowing halos.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every quantity, currency value, percentage, date, and metric MUST render in Azeret Mono with tabular numerals to guarantee column alignment across states.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Elevation Rule
rules.body: Blurry drop shadows are prohibited on cards and inline widgets. Depth is conveyed through tonal layering and hairline delineation.

dos: Do format all numerical data, match percentages, GPA values, and deadlines in Azeret Mono with tabular numbers.
Do keep corner radius at exactly 4px for all cards, containers, buttons, and inputs.
Do preserve the ultra-minimalist header: Logo + Glyph (left), Theme Toggle + Start Matching CTA (right).
Do present all opportunities and pipeline entries as seamless, authentic production records.
Do verify both Light ('Engineered Paper') and Dark ('Obsidian Grid') themes maintain strict WCAG AA contrast.
donts: Don't introduce rounded-full pill buttons or soft, bubble-like container corners.
Don't add colored neon glows (no cyan, purple, or green halos).
Don't use generic browser fonts or uncurated sans-serif stacks.
Don't reintroduce synthetic demo tags or [DEMO SPECIMEN] labels on records.
Don't clutter the primary header with secondary navigation links or sandbox buttons.
